model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the overall performance (in percentage) of various Large Language Models (LLMs) on the ABS-AOS pattern, with performance values ranging from approximately 24.64% to 61.09%. The vertical axis represents "Overall Performance (%)", scaled linearly from 0 to 60 with tick marks at intervals of 20. The horizontal axis lists ten distinct model categories, though they are not labeled with specific model names, and the bars are ordered from left to right in descending order of performance. The tallest bar on the far left reaches 61.09%, followed by 60.72% in the second bar, while the shortest bar, positioned third from the left, indicates 24.64%. The remaining bars display values in descending order: 48.28%, 48.83%, 27.22%, 54.83%, 43.79%, 46.36%, 44.09%, 40.87%, and 43.54%. Each bar is color-coded with distinct pastel shades, and the exact numerical value is displayed atop each bar for clarity. According to the caption, the models are stratified into three tiers based on their overall performance (OP_{GM}): Tier-1 (55–61%), Tier-2 (41–49%), and Tier-3 (25–27%), with the chart visually reflecting this distribution—two models fall into Tier-1 (61.09% and 60.72%), five into Tier-2 (48.28%, 48.83%, 43.79%, 46.36%, 44.09%, 40.87%, 43.54%), and two into Tier-3 (24.64% and 27.22%). The chart does not highlight or annotate any specific bars, presenting all models with equal visual emphasis.

The bars are color-coded and arranged from left to right in descending order of performance. The performance values are explicitly labeled on top of each bar. The chart visually groups models by performance level, with the first two bars (61.09% and 60.72%) falling into Tier-1, the next five bars (54.83% down to 43.79%) falling into Tier-2, and the last two bars (43.54% and 24.64%) falling into Tier-3.
